comparator.name: Econometrics and Data Science
comparator.sourceNotes: The official 2026–2027 curriculum provides a complete 180-EC structure. Years 1 and 2 each contain ten 6-EC components. Year 3 contains 30 EC of genuine open first-semester choice, an 18-EC specialisation and a 12-EC thesis seminar. The generic programme offers Econometrics and Data Science specialisations. Econometrics is selected under the broad-academic-identity rule because the official overview distinguishes the degree from more data-driven Business Analytics through its theory-driven econometric modelling of microeconomic, macroeconomic and policy questions; it is also listed first. Risk Theory is selected by official order from the two second-year restricted choices. Both decisions were fixed before UCR fit was assessed.
components: Compulsory shared-foundation course in actuarial valuation, pricing and reserving.
First-listed option selected neutrally from Risk Theory and Mathematical and Empirical Finance.
Free-choice electives: minor, study abroad, internship/electives or electives
Genuine open first-semester choice space preserved without inventing content.
Compulsory independent bachelor thesis and seminar.

routeSelection.basis: The normalized target is the generic Econometrics and Data Science degree. Current official evidence presents econometric model development, interpretation, economic causality and policy analysis as the programme’s distinctive broad identity, while Data Science is the more prediction- and automation-focused alternative. Econometrics is therefore selected as the representative route, independently of UCR fit; its first listing also supports the choice if the routes are treated as equally general.

alternatives.label: Econometrics, data science and economic forecasting
alternatives.concept: A mathematical, statistical and computational spine leads to econometrics, machine learning and quantitative analysis of economic behaviour, markets and policy. It is the closest feasible UCR response while remaining less specialised than UvA’s multi-course econometrics and thesis sequence.
alternatives.labelReason: The completed curriculum combines substantial mathematics, computing and data science with econometrics and multiple economic application courses.
progression: Verified against the current GitHub enriched UCR workbook: every course is available in its assigned Fall-2026-cohort term, all formal prerequisites occur earlier, first-year PPD is present and advanced quantitative courses follow suitable foundations where feasible.

alternatives.label: Data science, algorithms and AI optimization
alternatives.concept: Retains the mathematical and economic foundation but gives greater weight to software, algorithms, advanced mathematics, optimization, neural networks and reinforcement learning. It develops the programme’s Data Science direction as a distinct prediction-and-automation route rather than reproducing the Econometrics specialisation.
alternatives.labelReason: The completed curriculum’s distinguishing courses are software development, advanced calculus, optimization and reinforcement learning, supported by a broad data-science spine.
alternatives.distinctness: Relative to the closest match, 4 courses (BENGATE101, DISCOMP213, BENLEAD311, DISMATH214) replace 4 economics, behavioural and ethics courses. The 30-EC shift produces a technically deeper automation-and-optimization route rather than a relabelled econometrics programme.
progression: Verified against the current GitHub enriched UCR workbook: every course is available in its assigned Fall-2026-cohort term, all formal prerequisites occur earlier, first-year PPD is present and advanced computing and mathematics follow suitable foundations where feasible.

alternatives.label: Financial and organisational data analysis
alternatives.concept: Uses programming, data science, probability and econometrics to study finance, consumer and market evidence, international business, digital strategy and organisational decisions. It is an application-focused route grounded in the target’s financial-data and data-driven-organisation interests.
alternatives.labelReason: Finance, consumer economics, market research, governance and digital strategy are the material curricular consequences of this route.
alternatives.distinctness: Relative to the closest match, 8 courses change toward finance, markets and organisational strategy; relative to the AI route, 7 courses change. Both pairwise differences exceed the 30-EC floor and reflect the evidenced application choice rather than arbitrary substitutions.
progression: Verified against the current GitHub enriched UCR workbook: every course is available in its assigned Fall-2026-cohort term, all formal prerequisites occur earlier, first-year PPD is present and data foundations precede advanced business and econometric applications where feasible.

selection.assessment: The closest route owns the integrated econometrics core. The formally evidenced Data Science direction supports a technically distinct AI and automation curriculum, while financial data analysis and data-driven organisational decisions support a third application-focused route. All three are coherent, feasible and pairwise distinct by at least four courses, so production stops at the maximum.

notes.text: UvA provides successive calculus, linear algebra, probability, statistics and econometrics courses, an empirical project, a formal Econometrics specialisation and a 12-EC thesis seminar. UCR offers mathematics, statistics, programming, data science, machine learning and one dedicated Econometrics course, but not the same advanced econometric sequence, time-series and microeconometrics depth, life-insurance mathematics or embedded quantitative thesis requirement.
